a-model-can-learn-from-public-text-alone.header: A model can learn from public text alone
a-model-can-learn-from-public-text-alone.description: the LLaMA authors set out to show state-of-the-art models can be trained using publicly available datasets exclusively [1].

touvron-llama.title: Touvron et al., LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models

customer-conversations-are-not-training-.header: Customer conversations are not training data
customer-conversations-are-not-training-.description: Anthropic states that by default it does not use inputs or outputs of its commercial products for training, so a company's internal processes, decisions and naming are mostly absent from what a model learned [1].

anthropic-commercial-training.title: Anthropic, Is my data used for model training? (commercial products)

rare-facts-are-learned-poorly.description: accuracy on a fact question tracks how many training documents mention it, so even a fact that is in the data is weak when it is rare [1].

kandpal-long-tail.title: Kandpal et al., Large Language Models Struggle to Learn Long-Tail Knowledge

the-context-must-be-supplied.description: the retrieval literature's remedy is to pair the model with a searchable memory consulted at request time, which is why organisational knowledge has to arrive with the request [1].

lewis-rag.title: Lewis et al., Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

speed-not-context.title: Speed, not context
speed-not-context.script: Now give the same four cards to agents. Each card is ticked far faster, which is wonderful, and it is exactly where the trap sits. AI speeds up the doing, but it cannot add context that nobody gave it, and the paintball agent never saw the accessible bus.

plausible-guess.title: Plausible guess
plausible-guess.script: What makes this worse is that an agent which finds a gap tends to fill it with a plausible guess, instead of stopping to ask you. Nobody told the food agent what vegetarian means for these colleagues, so it picks the most common reading and carries on. The same four failures appear in the same four places, only now you reach them in two minutes instead of two weeks.
